title: [Kernel] Switch fp8 layers to use the CUTLASS kernels (#5183)

experiments.name: fp8_cutlass_scaled_mm
experiments.workload: neuralmagic/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct-FP8 end-to-end serving on GPU; fp8 linear layers routed through vLLM's CUTLASS cutlass_scaled_mm_dq kernel instead of torch._scaled_mm. Author reports 5-15% e2e improvement.
experiments.note: Diff adds cutlass_fp8_supported() and switches fp8 apply() to ops.cutlass_scaled_mm_dq when bias is None and CUTLASS is supported, else falls back to torch._scaled_mm. Author gives only a ratio/percent range (5-15% e2e on Llama-3-8B-FP8) plus a spreadsheet of GEMM-size comparisons; no absolute before/after tok/s published in the PR text.

reported.scope: end-to-end serving speedup on Llama-3-8B-Instruct-FP8; author quotes a 5-15% range (0.15 = the top of the range as headline)
reported.scale_short: Author published only a 5-15% E2E range (no absolute numbers) on FP8 Llama-3-8B; the kernel is CUTLASS fp8 GEMM which needs an fp8-capable GPU and cannot run on CPU. TO MAKE 1:1: run the FP8 model e2e on an fp8-capable GPU (e.g. H100) and compare tok/s with torch._scaled_mm vs cutlass_scaled_mm_dq.
reported.scale_note: The win is a GPU fp8 GEMM kernel swap; magnitude varies with GEMM shape (per the linked spreadsheet and PR #5144 size sweep), so the 5-15% is an e2e range rather than a single isolated-op ratio. Recorded at the top of the author's range; there is no absolute baseline to anchor and no CPU path to time.

reported.note: author gave a ratio/percentage only; applied to our reproduced baseline
